acceptanceCriteria: Node script locates PostgreSQL 18 executable suite or errors, creates cluster in chmod 700 temp with listen_addresses empty and session-local socket, and cleans up even on error.
At runtime script executes fixture, official preflight, 66 on-disk sorted migrations with one file transaction each, official auth-bootstrap+seed+postflight.
A missing earlier producer fails at exact migrating filename; no fallback stub/dynamic SQL injection allowed.
Checks real browser role denial for sensitive Office tables, privileged v2/v3 rights, enabled 0060 queue triggers and rollback-only positive/negative SQL DML.
Only tests/fixtures and optional script changed; no host connection, no CI deployment; Vitest and TypeScript/regression/Control Plane risk gates PASS.
Script must report local-emulated-postgres proof only and manifest remains snapshot-reviewed/Pro dependency OPEN.
invariants: No PostgreSQL server listens on TCP, no externally configurable database host or credentials.
All migrations executed directly from ordered customer-baseline, never merged/filtered according to test expectation.
Missing schema/role rights and real SQL error fail closed, not warning-only.
All inserted fixture data rolled back, process and temp dir cleaned.
No source migration or customer data mutation.

specialistReviews.finding: Trust authentication on test PG cluster and emulated Supabase roles can be dangerous if TCP exposed or used for hosted acceptance.
specialistReviews.resolution: Restrict cluster to private socket chmod 700, explicitly set listen_addresses empty, do not accept host DSN, clean process/temp; retain partial status.

specialistReviews.finding: Local PG fixture can drift from real Supabase schema but executes real FK/CHECK/TRIGGER logic, so report scope precisely.
specialistReviews.resolution: Official pre/postflight + deterministic ordered SQL and negative semantics; full Supabase-native proof later.

specialistReviews.finding: Harness is test-only quality-infrastructure, not a database DDL production change.
specialistReviews.resolution: Bound four test-only files, exact parent and Control Plane gates, no CI auto-trigger.

specialistReviews.finding: Reusable local runner must not leave costly sandbox resources or local Postgres processes running.
specialistReviews.resolution: try/finally server stop+rm; no external project or Preview.

challenge.scenario: Run harness with PGHOST set to a hosted Supabase endpoint.
challenge.finding: An unsafe harness might mistakenly apply 66 migrations to production.
challenge.resolution: Override PostgreSQL connection env with private Unix socket, fixed test db and random port; reject remote connection inputs.

challenge.scenario: A missing producer causes migration N to fail while static tests PASS.
challenge.finding: False readiness repeats template re-acceptance failure pattern.
challenge.resolution: Run exactly sorted on-disk SQL, report first failing file with psql exit and do not retry with ad hoc SQL.

challenge.scenario: A bad test SQL exits early leaving an elevated Postgres server running.
challenge.finding: Leaked local trust cluster or unnecessary ongoing cost.
challenge.resolution: Runner uses finally cleanup, PostgreSQL only listens on chmod 700 socket, temp directory removed.

challenge.scenario: A prior PostgreSQL/Supabase environment exports authentication tokens and CWD connection vars.
challenge.finding: Sandbox rehearsal could pick up ambient credentials.
challenge.resolution: Use an explicit PGHOST private path, PGUSER postgres, PGDATABASE local in subprocesses; no provider calls.

challenge.scenario: An Office message function grants insecure v2 EXECUTE to service_role after 0054.
challenge.finding: Legacy sender-only conversation merge bypass can become callable.
challenge.resolution: Actual has_function_privilege checks fail closed on anon/authenticated/service_role, v3 service_role only.

challenge.scenario: A later SQL disables RLS on the private Office attachments table.
challenge.finding: Source-only SAST tests may not discover effective role exposure.
challenge.resolution: Run pg_class.relrowsecurity and actual SET ROLE SELECT attempts expecting permission denied.

challenge.scenario: Canonical reply trigger gets recreated as BEFORE INSERT only.
challenge.finding: An existing job UPDATE can bypass tenant/mailbox validation.
challenge.resolution: Check actual pg_trigger enabled mask plus rollback-only payload tag-add/strip/modify rejection.

challenge.scenario: The fixture simulates auth.users but not full Supabase managed internals.
challenge.finding: A local PG PASS is incorrectly advertised as complete native Supabase integration.
challenge.resolution: Label proof LOCAL_POSTGRES_TEST_FIXTURE, leave manifest snapshot-reviewed; require hosted-equivalent disposable testing before DONE.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: F18 first real PostgreSQL baseline exercise found a genuine missing pre-0054 producer that 133/133 static tests missed. A one-off /tmp command sequence is not reproducible and can silently regress when later migrations are added. Implement a guarded read-only-to-repository, local-only isolated postgres execution harness: fail closed without PG18 executables, create a socket-only disposable PG cluster, supply minimal explicit Supabase Auth/Storage schema and roles for compatibility, execute official clean-target preflight, all on-disk migration files lexicographically in transactional order, auth-bootstrap+seed+postflight, and actual negative RLS/grant and Office reply UPDATE trigger tests; return nonzero first failing SQL without changing any production repo SQL or hosted database.
observableOutcomes: New standalone node script verifies local PostgreSQL server commands and creates its own secure temp data/socket directory with listen_addresses empty (no TCP), runs entire on-disk customer-baseline SQL without per-file manual insertion.

Test-only Supabase shim fixture contains anon/authenticated/service_role/supabase_admin roles, auth.uid()/jwt(), minimal auth.users and storage.buckets/objects columns; fixtures explicitly NOT Supabase runtime parity.
Official target-preflight, auth-bootstrap, seed, postflight all executed on clean target, any failure aborts.

Database assertions effective legacy v2 revokes and v3 grant, Office sensitive table effective grants/RLS, enabled INSERT+UPDATE reply guard and UPDATE immutability, and rollback-only DML negative tests.
No GitHub workflow, package auto-trigger or CI charge; explicit opt-in local node command only, new unit has tests validating safety and fail-closed behavior.
On exit all processes stopped and temporary folders deleted; no real target connection secrets or external network DB path accepted; no full Supabase/Pro-ready claim.
unresolvedRisks: Actual PostgreSQL 18/supabase compatibility fixture is not full managed Supabase Auth, Storage, JWT, Realtime or object ACL; source-only RLS and local role proof cannot certify hosted runtime.
Local postgres initdb bootstrap uses trust only on private chmod 700 Unix socket, no TCP and no long-running service; isolation must be tested.
Postgres command binary versions, package paths or local system constraints may block opt-in harness; hard fail with actionable error rather than skip pretending PASS.
A test-only fixture can diverge from Supabase managed schema in future; require active maintenance and eventual disposable Supabase-native acceptance.
CLI timeout/sandbox termination can interrupt cleanup; temp directory randomized and no privileged hosted services used; sandbox teardown is secondary failsafe.
